title: Peach Aviation reportedly says 延べ最大約944万件 of records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: The page gives Peach's 26 November notice date; its own post is dated 27 November.
geo_basis: country as stated; the page read does not name a city
summary: Rocket Boys reports that Peach Aviation disclosed on 26 November that customer data held in PLAID KARTE was leaked, 延べ最大約944万件 (a cumulative record count). The page says this is a record count, not confirmation that 944万 people were affected. Listed items are name, date of birth, postal code, address, phone number and email address. It says no misuse had been confirmed as of 26 November.
plain: Peach Aviation reportedly says customer data kept in a marketing contractor service leaked, 延べ最大約944万件 (a cumulative record count, not a count of people, the report says).
exec: A report says 延べ最大約944万件 of Peach Aviation customer records leaked via a contractor service; no misuse had been confirmed as of 26 November.

sources.name: Rocket Boys Security Measures Lab (relays Peach's 26 November notice; the notice itself could not be loaded)

evidence.quote: 漏えい対象は延べ最大約944万件です。
最大約944万件という数字はデータの延べ件数であり、944万人の漏えいを確認したという意味ではありません。

validation.note: Only one page was read (Rocket Boys, relaying Peach's notice). Peach's own English PDF notice would not load (connection hang-up on three tries); PLAID's 20 November page does not name Peach.

review.note: figure qualifier: removed English about/up-to-about wording, kept the source's 延べ最大約944万件 in title and summary; data items and no-misuse date match Rocket Boys
